body.name: MOM_beta
body.def: Writing \(n=m b_n(\beta)+r_\beta\) with \(0\le r_\beta<b_n(\beta)\), \(\operatorname{MOM}_{\beta}(W_1,\ldots,W_n)\) is the \(\lceil b_n(\beta)/2\rceil\)-th order statistic of the averages over consecutive blocks, the first \(r_\beta\) of size \(m+1\) and the remainder of size \(m\)
